articles.title: I’ll Dismantle All Four of You
articles.description: “I will dismantle all four of you.” What starts as a conversation quickly turns into a fight challenge — and Chael Sonnen is more than happy to accept. There’s no hesitation. “Do you want it now?” Yes. But then comes the real question. What happens when somebody gets submitted? Chael asks the challenger if he knows enough about fighting to recognize when it's time to tap. The exchange turns from playful to serious as Chael breaks down what actually happens when someone steps up and challenges a trained fighter. Does the challenger feel foolish for calling him out? Chael doesn't see it that way. He challenged someone to a fight. Now the answer is yes. So what happens next? #ChaelSonnen #MMA #UFC #FightChallenge #CombatSports #Submission #MMAFighter #ChaelSonnenPodcast

articles.title: Islam Makhachev Wants 20 Straight Wins… So What?
articles.description: Islam Makhachev reportedly has a goal of reaching 20 consecutive UFC wins. Chael Sonnen has no problem with the goal but he has a problem with calling it a record. Coach Javier Mendez says Islam is motivated by reaching 20 straight victories after recently passing Anderson Silva's historic UFC winning streak. That's an incredible accomplishment, but Chael argues there's an important distinction between an official record and a number a fighter chooses as a personal milestone. If 20 straight matters, why not 10? Why not three? Where does an undefeated streak begin when you've already been defeated? Chael looks at how combat sports define records, why language around championships matters, and how fighters like Matt Hughes have helped create unofficial accomplishments that eventually get treated as fact. Islam doesn't need favors or manufactured accolades. He's still seeking the toughest challenges available. But if he reaches 20 straight victories, Chael has one warning: don't expect the record books to suddenly create a new category for him. #ChaelSonnen #IslamMakhachev #UFC #MMA #JavierMendez Bad Guy Inc merch now available at https://BadGuyInc.com Click here to subscribe: https://bit.ly/3FrHIPK Follow me on IG: https://bit.ly/3HY7BIE Follow me on Twitter: https://bit.ly/3tvY5J7 Follow me on Threads https://www.threads.com/@sonnench

articles.title: Why Chael Sonnen doesn't hate Tito Ortiz anymore
articles.description: Would Chael Sonnen publicly apologize to Tito Ortiz? No. But the reason has nothing to do with selling a fight. Chael looks back on one of the most personal moments from his legendary rivalry with Tito Ortiz — the moment Tito looked him directly in the face, took the microphone, paused, and simply said: “I hate you.” For Chael, that word meant something. He grew up being taught not to use the word “hate.” It wasn't something you casually said about another person. So when Tito said it, Chael remembers being genuinely taken aback. This wasn't trash talk. It wasn't a promotional line. Chael believed Tito meant it. And that's what made the moment stick with him all these years later. Chael breaks down the emotional side of his rivalry with Tito Ortiz and explains why, despite everything that happened between them, he never hated Tito back. #ChaelSonnen #TitoOrtiz #MMA #UFC #MMAHistory #ChaelSonnenPodcast #FightHistory #UFCNews #CombatSports

articles.title: Dan Hooker Is Taking the “Danger Money” #ufc
articles.description: Usman Nurmagomedov has an opponent. Dan Hooker. And Chael Sonnen explains why Hooker may have just taken the fight that nobody else wanted. Hooker called out Usman directly, saying other fighters wouldn't take the risk — but he would. Chael calls it a classic case of “danger money.” When the UFC or another promotion comes to you with a fight nobody else wants, you know why they're calling. And sometimes, that means a little extra cheddar. But Chael's bigger question is aimed at the PFL lightweight roster. Why wasn't anyone else calling out Usman Nurmagomedov? Chael believes every 155-pound fighter in the organization should have been screaming his name. Not necessarily because they expect to fight him immediately, but because calling out a star creates attention, leverage, and opportunity. If Usman stays with the organization, those fighters could eventually get the matchup — and suddenly, they may have the power to negotiate their own price. According to Chael, fighters don't always understand the business side of the game. But Dan Hooker does. #UsmanNurmagomedov #DanHooker #PFL #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #MMAAnalysis #UFCNews #MMAFighters #CombatSports

articles.title: Does Umar Nurmagomedov Deserve a Rematch? #ufc
articles.description: Does Umar Nurmagomedov deserve an immediate rematch with Song Yadong? The idea came from Henry Cejudo, who believes Umar would win nine out of 10 times if the two fought again. Chael Sonnen understands the argument. Based on what he saw, Chael says he would likely pick Umar in a rematch. He also agrees with the idea that the better fighter may not have fought better on that particular night. But is that enough to justify an immediate rematch? Chael doesn't think so. The first fight was competitive, and Song Yadong won. So what exactly was on the line that requires an immediate do-over? What has Umar lost that needs to be immediately given back? At 135 pounds, the UFC bantamweight division is loaded with dangerous contenders. Every fight at the top of the division matters, and Chael argues that trying to create a perfect pecking order is nearly impossible. Would Umar beat Song in a rematch? Maybe. But Chael believes that's not necessarily a reason to run it back immediately. #UmarNurmagomedov #SongYadong #HenryCejudo #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #UFCBantamweight #MMAAnalysis #UFCNews #FightNight

articles.title: 🚨 Dana White DISAGREES w/ Athletic Commission “FINE THE SH*T OUT OF HIM”
articles.description: Dana White says not every fighter who jumps out of the Octagon should be punished. 👀 Asked whether the UFC needs stronger deterrents for fighters leaving the cage after fights, Dana said there should be a clear distinction. If a fighter gets caught up in the emotion of a huge win and jumps the cage to celebrate? Dana doesn’t think it’s a big deal. But if someone jumps the cage with bad intentions toward another fighter or somebody in the crowd? Dana’s answer: 🔥 “Fine the sh*t out of him.” White says fighters sacrifice months away from their families, endure brutal training camps and cut weight — so sometimes emotion takes over after a victory. His position: celebration and violence shouldn’t receive the same punishment. 👇 DO YOU AGREE WITH DANA — SHOULD THERE BE DIFFERENT LEVELS OF PUNISHMENT?

articles.title: Usman’s cage jump was awesome #ufc
articles.description: What Usman Nurmagomedov did was wrong. Chael Sonnen wants to make that absolutely clear. He wasn't allowed to do it. He broke the rules. But Chael also has to be honest about what he saw. It was awesome. Umar Nurmagomedov was down and in trouble, and his brother cared so much that nothing was going to stop him from getting to Umar — not the rules, not the fence, and not even Khabib Nurmagomedov trying to hold him back. Then the chaos escalated. As Song Yadong moved toward Usman, Usman reacted with an incredible move to avoid the confrontation. Chael compares the technique to something straight out of Jon Jones' playbook and calls it one of the best moments of the entire night. Now, some fans are calling for Usman to be punished or dismissed. Chael understands why. Athletic commissions may take the situation seriously, and there could absolutely be consequences for crossing the fence and entering the area. But on a human level? Chael sees something else. A brother saw his brother down. And he was going to get to him. #UsmanNurmagomedov #UmarNurmagomedov #SongYadong #KhabibNurmagomedov #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #MMAAnalysis #UFCNews #FightNight

articles.title: Umar Nurmagomedov Finally Got Caught #ufc
articles.description: Umar Nurmagomedov finally got caught — and Chael Sonnen believes it was only a matter of time. After the fight, chaos erupted as Usman Nurmagomedov attempted to get over the fence to reach his brother. Even Khabib Nurmagomedov tried to stop him, grabbing his leg as the situation unfolded. But Chael's biggest takeaway was what happened inside the fight. He gives Song Yadong full credit for the victory. However, Chael says he didn't necessarily leave believing the better fighter won. Instead, he believes the fighter who fought better won that night. There's a difference. Chael explains that when a team trains together for years, their tendencies can eventually become predictable. Sooner or later, opponents start recognizing the patterns — the level changes, the attacks to the body, and the entries. Against an opponent with longer reach, even a tiny delay can be catastrophic. A millisecond longer to change levels. A millisecond longer to reach the target. And in that millisecond, the punch lands. Chael breaks down why Umar lost the element of surprise — and how Song Yadong capitalized on the smallest opening possible. #UmarNurmagomedov #SongYadong #KhabibNurmagomedov #UsmanNurmagomedov #UFC #MMA #ChaelSonnen #UFCNews #MMAAnalysis #FightBreakdown
